source_text: Indue sacerdotes ad gloriam et decorem. Gloria animae virtus; decor ordo caritatis. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Clothe priests for glory and beauty. Glory of-soul virtue; beauty order of-charity. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Clothe the priests for glory and beauty >> Bible:Exodus 28:40]]. The soul’s glory is virtue; its beauty is ordered love. Homilia VI CLOSEOUT. Amen.
